methods.name: insert_if_new

methods.summary: Inserts each value from `values` into the map, invoking `payload_fn` for each value if *not* already present, deferring the allocation of the payload until it is needed.

methods.name: into_state
methods.summary: Converts this set into a `StringViewArray`, or `BinaryViewArray`, containing each distinct value that was inserted. This is done without copying the values.

methods.summary: Return the total size, in bytes, of memory used to store the data in this set, not including `self`

methods.name: take
